description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Curilla
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Seraph Blade (0~2), removed after using Apex Seraph Blade two times

description.text: Increases Apex Seraph Blade level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Curilla]

description.text: Keeps track of Apex Seraph Blade level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Curilla]
